top_signals.title: UK regulator to investigate Pornhub parent company for alleged age verification failings
top_signals.summary: In May, Pornhub began using a new age assurance process to verify some users’ ages, according to an Ofcom press release. The new method relies on signals from Apple that suggest under 18s in the UK “may have completed Apple’s age checks,” the press release said.
